_readme: Which folder in incoming-models/ is the 3D source for each dish id. Dishes not listed use the folder with the same name. Read by the Phase 2 pipeline.

steak-main.why: The 'tomahawk-steak' scan is the same geometry as the old ribeye model (100% vertex match) with 2048px textures instead of 512px. Owner confirmed it is the Premium Ribeye Steak; tomahawk removed from dishes.csv until it has its own scan.

bz-chicken-pizza.why: Pitch placeholder: an AI-generated model (Tripo) of Baraza's chicken pizza, supplied by the owner as pizza+3d+model+baraza.usdz (72 MB, 1.95M triangles). Pre-processed with scripts/prep-usdz.mjs to 40k triangles. Replace with the real scan after the pitch.

hd-san-sebastian.why: Real Apple Object Capture scan (Sab sabastein.zip). OBJ + 2K colour/normal/AO → scripts/prep-obj.mjs --grade 'sat=1.06,contrast=1.06,sharpen=0.6,warm=3'. Roughness 0.8: soft sheen on cream and sauce, not plastic.

hd-cookie-dough.why: Real Apple Object Capture scan (Cookie dough.zip). prep-obj --grade 'shadows=0.85,warmShadows=4,sat=1.06,contrast=1.06,sharpen=0.6'.

hd-matilda-cake.why: Real Apple Object Capture scan (Matilda.zip). Repairs: the chocolate top was crushed to near-black → shadow lift (--grade 'shadows=0.72,warmShadows=10,sat=1.06,contrast=1.04,sharpen=0.7'); a see-through tear in the foil wrap's back corner, just under the rim → closed with prep-obj --patch (ring mapped by picking a render at '-25deg 55deg 30%'; ring saved as incoming-models/hd-matilda-cake/tear-ring.json).
